newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly oil product stocks up sharply.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly oil product stocks up sharply.

text.p: Singapore weekly residue stocks rose sharply by 1.04 million barrels in the week ended September 11 to 9.862 million barrels, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
Middle-distillate stocks rose by 888,000 barrels to 7.913 million barrels.
Middle distillates comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
Light distillate stocks also rose by 411,000 barrels to 5.645 million barrels. They comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha. -- Singapore newsroom (65-870-3082)
